Cloud Infrastructure & DevOps Engineer
Chargebee
Remote, India

About Chargebee:
Chargebee powers subscription billing and revenue management for global SaaS companies.

Responsibilities:
• Manage AWS cloud infrastructure, Kubernetes clusters, and Terraform configurations.
• Maintain robust CI/CD pipelines, Docker containers, and monitoring tools.
• Ensure 99.99% availability, scalability, and disaster recovery.

Requirements:
• 3-5 years of experience in DevOps or Site Reliability Engineering.
• Expertise in AWS, Docker, Kubernetes, Terraform, Linux, and CI/CD.
• Fully remote position.
